stories.headline: Trump says Ukraine and Russia have agreed 'energy ceasefire' - BBC

stories.perspective_two: Critics argue that premature or unfounded claims risk undermining diplomatic credibility and may complicate efforts by officially recognized parties striving for a genuine ceasefire.
